![The-NLP-Pandect](./Resources/Images/pandect.png)

This pandect (πανδέκτης is Ancient Greek for encyclopedia) was created to help you find almost anything related to Natural Language Processing that is available online.

> __Note__ > Quick legend on available resource types: > > ⭐ - open source project, usually a GitHub repository with its number of stars > > 📙 - resource you can read, usually a blog post or a paper > > 🗂️ - a collection of additional resources > > 🔱 - non-open source tool, framework or paid service > > 🎥️ - a resource you can watch > > 🎙️ - a resource you can listen to ###
